headline: Steady compounder, growth cooling
chart_note: 52-week range: $283.47 - $341.75. Currently $309.56, about 9% off the 52-week high.
why_today: Q2 revenue rose 3.7% YoY to $7.1B, meeting estimates, but comparable sales growth slowed to 1.3% from 3.8% a year ago - a sign the pace of the turnaround is cooling even as the stock stays a low-volatility dividend compounder.
pro_1: Analyst consensus is Buy (75% buy, 41 analysts), average price target $337 implies room back to highs
pro_2: Beta of just 0.41 - one of the most defensive large caps in the market
con_1: US same-store sales growth decelerated sharply quarter over quarter
con_2: At 25x earnings it is not cheap for a business growing revenue under 4%
